title: From Papa
kidHtml:
Hey Sairah 💛

It's Papa. Friday evening — the week's nearly done! Let's spend a few minutes together and grow a little, you and me.

First, just you:

  1. What was the best moment of your week so far — even a tiny one?
  2. If you got to plan our Sunday morning, what would we do?

Now a little detective work. Five friends ran a race at school: Aarav, Bina, Chirag, Diya and Esha. Here's what we know:

  • Aarav finished ahead of Chirag.
  • Chirag finished ahead of Diya.
  • Esha came in just before Diya, and Bina came in just after Diya.
  1. Work out the finishing order, first to last. How did you figure it out?
  2. Who came third?

A quick one about thinking straight. Imagine I say: "Every mango in this box is ripe. This mango came from the box, so it's ripe." Then I say: "This mango is ripe, so it must have come from the box."

  1. Is one of those smarter than the other? Which one would you trust, and why?

And one to think about with your heart. Your teacher adds up a test and, by mistake, gives you 2 extra marks. Those 2 marks put you just ahead of your good friend for the top spot. Nobody would ever find out.

  1. What would you do — and how do you think you'd feel afterwards?
  2. Would your answer change if the mistake had helped someone you don't get along with? Be honest with me.

There's no wrong answer on that last part — I just love hearing how you think. Have a lovely Friday evening. — Papa
